to: you: only the socket of the character

variants.name: Status
variants.when: The Merrit loop, every 15 s while your stand is open; and after a gift. `reasons` is empty when a visit can come.

variants.name: Info
variants.when: The reply to `interaction` with `type: "merrit_info"`. It adds `account_last`. The server ignores a second request within 3 s.

account_last.name: Merchant
account_last.reason: Your shop stayed stocked for two minutes and left the neighbors room.

variants.name: Stand
variants.when: The `merchant` handler opened or closed the stand, or changed the item. It adds `stand_opened`.

variants.name: Unreachable
variants.when: Merrit chose you but found no path to your stand. `reasons` is only `[{code: "unreachable"}]`; `next_at`, `last` and `server_now` are of the real status (you qualified, so `next_at` is usually in the past). The next try comes after 30 s.

variants.name: Error
variants.when: The reply to `merrit_info` when the read of the account fails.

MerritStatus.summary: Why Merrit, the market patron NPC, does not visit your stand now, and when the next visit can come.

fields.name: reasons
fields.description: Each condition that blocks a visit now. Empty when a visit can come.

fields.name: next_at
fields.description: The earliest time of the next visit, in ms since the Unix epoch. It is the larger of the end of the cooldown and the end of `warming`. `0` when the server knows neither.

fields.name: last
fields.description: The receipt of the last gift to this character (`player.p.merrit_receipt`), or `null` (node/logic/market_patron_runtime.js:62).

fields.name: server_now
fields.description: The time of the server when it built the status, in ms since the Unix epoch.

fields.name: account_last
fields.description: Only in the reply to `merrit_info`: the last gift to any character of the account (`owner.info.merrit`), or `null` (node/logic/market_patron_runtime.js:77, 82).

fields.name: stand_opened
fields.description: Only after the `merchant` handler: `true` when the stand is open now.

MerritStatusError.summary: The `merrit_status` that the server sends when it cannot read the account.

MerritStatusReason.summary: One condition that blocks a visit of Merrit.
MerritStatusReason.description: The server adds the codes in this order: `npc`, `stand_close` and `stand_front` (one per blocker), `area`, `closed`, `listing`. Then `warming`, only when the list is empty. Then `cooldown` and `inventory`. `unreachable` and `unavailable` replace the list. The distances come from `G.npcs.citizen22.market` (node/logic/market_patron.js:29-68).

fields.name: code
fields.description: `npc`: a fixed NPC is within `npc_clearance`. `stand_close`: an older stand is within `stand_clearance`. `stand_front`: an older stand is in front (within `front_width` sideways and `front_clearance` up or down). `area`: the stand is not in a market area of `main`. `closed`: no open stand (or dead, moving, disconnected, in the bank). `listing`: no item on the stand that qualifies. `warming`: the stand has not stayed in place for `settle_ms`. `cooldown`: the account got a gift less than `hour_ms` ago. `inventory`: no space for a `marketparcel`. `unreachable`: Merrit found no path. `unavailable`: the server could not read the account.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Only for `npc`, `stand_close` and `stand_front`: the name of the NPC or of the character with the other stand.

fields.name: distance
fields.description: Only for `npc`, `stand_close` and `stand_front`: the distance to that NPC or stand.

fields.name: remaining_ms
fields.description: Only for `warming` and `cooldown`: the time until that condition ends.

senders.what: The Merrit loop: every 15 s to each character in the instance with an open stand.
The `merchant` handler, when the stand or its item changes.
The Merrit loop: no path to the chosen stand.
